question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **'On.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• 
 In the Fourth line of the passage:

 
 
• *'*As the poet droned (4) ______ Raman fell asleep*.'*
 
• **'On'** would be the correct option as '**Droned on**' means to talk for a long time in a boring way.
